title: Case 010: Recipient wants delivery held during a short absence

details.data: Entirely synthetic; English; fictional geography; all times UTC

context: The shipment is at a depot and has not entered the delivery route. Dispatch permits a three-day hold for this service.
initial_request: I am away and return on 2026-02-14. Please hold the parcel and release it on 2026-02-14, not earlier.
overview: The escalation snapshot comprises history events 001–002. Event 003 records the next agent action; the subsequent events provide the disclosed calibration follow-through. Facts learned later must not be used as if already known at escalation.

next_action.summary: Request an eligible temporary hold from dispatch using the recipient's confirmed return date.

outcome: Dispatch confirms the hold and the planned release date; no delivery is claimed.
boundaries: No delivery date or physical receipt follows merely from the planned release.

events.body: DL-010 is in depot stock. This service allows a hold up to three calendar days before routing. A confirmed release date is required.
I am away and return on 2026-02-14. Please hold the parcel and release it on 2026-02-14, not earlier.
Please apply the eligible three-day hold to DL-010, with release on 2026-02-14 as requested in Daro’s verified order thread. Confirm the stock and routing status.
DL-010 is marked HOLD in depot stock through 2026-02-13. Release to routing is scheduled for 2026-02-14. That is a release date, not a guaranteed delivery date.
